changelog: ✦ MT5 File Chooser WebView Fix: Perbaikan intent chooser native Android & expansi touch overlay file input untuk pembacaan screenshot 100% mulus.
✦ MT5 OCR Touch Overlay & Direct Vision: Perbaikan pemilih file Android WebView overlay penuh & engine Gemini Vision mandiri langsung di HP.
✦ MT5 Screenshot Scan (Gemini Vision OCR): Impor otomatis riwayat trading MT5 ke Jurnal Trading lewat screenshot hasil trade.
✦ Global Scroll Guard: Mencegah konflik gesture pull-to-refresh Android saat scroll chart & dialog overlay.
